sections.text:
Extreme sensitiveness to touch, but hard
pressure relieves. Coldness; much sweat. One hand
icy cold, the other warm. Anasarca. [Ars.; Apis.]

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Drowsiness. Unrefreshing or constant stupor.
Wakens early. Protracted sleeplessness. Anxious,
frightful dreams with confused consciousness on waking,
so that the dream cannot be rid of and fear of dream
remains. Snoring, especially with children.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Intermittent, paroxysms anticipate ; return
every week. All stages well marked. Every little ex-
ertion causes free perspiration. Chili generally in fore-
noon, commencing in breast; thirst before chill, and
little and often. Debilitating night-sweats.

sections.text:
Worse, slightest touch. [Plumb;
Caps.]. Draught of air; every other day; loss of vital
fluids; at night; after eating; bending over. Better,
bending double; hard piessure; open air; better warmth.
